Short title and commencement

ACT XVII OF 1994
SINDH CIVIL COURTS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
ACT XVII OF 1994
An Act to further amend the Sindh Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 27th July, 1994]
No. PAS/Legis-B-12/94, dated
27-7-1994.--The Sindh Civil Courts (Amendment) Bill having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 1st June, 1994 and assented to by
the Governor of Sindh on 20th July, 1994 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh:--
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Sindh Civil Courts (Amendment) Act, 1994.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 18 of Sindh Ordinance II of 1962

ACT XVII OF 1994
SINDH CIVIL COURTS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
ACT XVII OF 1994
An Act to further amend the Sindh Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 27th July, 1994]
No. PAS/Legis-B-12/94, dated
27-7-1994.--The Sindh Civil Courts (Amendment) Bill having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 1st June, 1994 and assented to by
the Governor of Sindh on 20th July, 1994 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh:--
2. Amendment of section 18 of Sindh Ordinance II of 1962.--In the
Sindh Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962, in section 18, in subsection (1), in clause
(a), for the words "two lacs and fifty thousand", the words
"five hundred thousand" shall be substituted.

Repeal

ACT XVII OF 1994
SINDH CIVIL COURTS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
ACT XVII OF 1994
An Act to further amend the Sindh Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 27th July, 1994]
No. PAS/Legis-B-12/94, dated
27-7-1994.--The Sindh Civil Courts (Amendment) Bill having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 1st June, 1994 and assented to by
the Governor of Sindh on 20th July, 1994 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh:--
3. Repeal.--The Sindh Civil Courts (Amendment) Ordinance, 1994 is
hereby repealed.
